meta.disclaimer: National definitions and collection methods differ widely. Time series are not comparable 1:1 across countries. The map headline sum is a sum of latest reported national estimates, not a global census total.
gaps: Most OECD HC3.1 countries publish a single latest-year headline here; multi-year series are included only where an official national time series was verified.
US HUD PIT 2021 national total omitted: pandemic disruptions meant a full comparable national (sheltered+unsheltered) total was not published the same way.
No official monthly national person totals published for Australia (ABS Census) or United States (HUD PIT) — chart months grain falls back to annual points.
GB series is England autumn rough sleeping snapshot only (not full UK homelessness / ETHOS).
Ukraine: single verified official year (Ministry service recipients 2026); Depaul 57k–121k estimate not plotted as a headcount series.
Russia series uses census homeless-household counts only (2002/2010/2021); not ETHOS-comparable.
Canada PiT series below is the 56-community comparable Everyone Counts enumeration — differs from OECD HC3.1 map headline (65,083).

meta.grainNote: Primary visual is a line chart. Published cadence is annual (US PIT) or multi-year Census (AU); monthly national series are not available.

series.name: Australia
series.definition: ABS Census estimating homelessness (Census night). ABS notes 2021 boarding-house / temporary-lodging groups are not fully comparable with earlier Censuses due to greater use of administrative data.

series.name: United States
series.definition: HUD Point-in-Time (PIT) count of people experiencing sheltered or unsheltered homelessness on a single night in January. Definitions differ from ABS/OECD.

series.name: England rough sleeping snapshot
series.definition: GOV.UK autumn single-night rough sleeping snapshot for England only. Narrower than ETHOS homelessness; not UK-wide (excludes Scotland, Wales, NI) and not a full homelessness headcount.

series.name: London rough sleeping snapshot
series.definition: London column of the England autumn rough sleeping snapshot (Table 2.1.1). Same definition limits as the England series.

series.name: Ukraine (Ministry service recipients)
series.definition: Ministry of Social Policy count of people who received services at homeless facilities as of 1 Jan 2026 (12,451), cited in Depaul Ukraine 2026 study. Depaul estimate range 57k–121k is a separate research estimate and is not plotted here.

series.name: Russia (census homeless households)
series.definition: Rosstat population-census count of people in homeless households (домохозяйства бездомных). Not ETHOS / OECD-comparable. Lifetime prevalence survey percentages are not used as headcounts.

series.name: Canada (Everyone Counts PiT, 56 communities)
series.definition: Comparable Everyone Counts PiT enumeration across the same 56 communities (2018 / 2020–22 / 2024). Differs from the OECD HC3.1 map headline. Year 2021 stands for the 2020–2022 coordinated count window.
